question: Which third temple element arising on the bhadra and malaya must be omitted?
premises: A third temple element is under consideration.
This element arises on the bhadra and malaya.
The prescribed action is abandonment of that element.
inference: The third bhadra-born temple element on the bhadra and malaya must be omitted.
plain_english: One should abandon the third temple element born on the bhadra when it occurs on the bhadra and the malaya.
